name: pboc_get_policy_rate
description:
A Chinese policy interest rate in percent from FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis): both rate_type values read the same FRED series, INTDSRCNM193N (IMF discount-rate series for China); these tools do not provide the Loan Prime Rate.
Returns: series_code (FRED id), series_id, label, source, observation_count and observations (date, value) oldest first, missing values dropped.
Inputs (none required): rate_type (lending or deposit; default lending; same data either way); start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD); recent_periods (1-500; the last N observations; with no dates it looks back N x 45 days); omit all three for the full history.
For market rates use pboc_get_cgb_yield. Needs a FRED API key (FRED_API_KEY, config fred.api.key); without one the call fails with a message saying so.
Example: {"rate_type": "lending", "start_date": "2015-01-01"}
